# Hearth smart home app (code.in.30s)
Smart home control mobile app. Clean modern style: soft rounded cards (20-24px radius), full-round pill search bars and chips, clean geometric sans (Outfit), big bold headings, small muted subtext. ONE vivid orange accent #F2762E used sparingly: pills, active nav icon, toggles ON, the centered + floating action button and ONE highlighted full-orange device card per screen. Floating rounded bottom nav bar with a centered orange round + FAB. Thin rounded line icons. Status chips like 'On', 'Auto', 'Away'. No gradients except a photo scrim, no neon, no emoji.
## Light: warm off-white page #F5F2EE, cards #FFFFFF, raised #ECE7E1, ink charcoal #1A1A1A, muted #8C8782. Same orange #F2762E accent.

screens.name: projects/11119557533319828808/screens/f874d1d0fa2247e2a866835bd0cf289b
screens.prompt:
Create a mobile smart home control screen for 'Hearth' in LIGHT mode (viewport 390x844).
Color palette strictly:
- Warm off-white background: #F5F2EE
- Cards: pure white #FFFFFF
- Raised control pills/buttons: #ECE7E1
- Charcoal ink headings & primary text: #1A1A1A
- Muted warm grey small subtext: #8C8782
- Vivid orange accent: #F2762E (used for pills, toggles ON, active nav, + FAB, and the highlighted card)
- Clean geometric sans Outfit font (bold headings, crisp small subtext). No gradients, no emoji, thin clean rounded line icons (lucide or heroicons style).

Screen Content and Structure:
1. Top Bar:
- Small round avatar with profile photo/initial, next to greeting "Hi, Aarav" (charcoal bold) and sub-line "Home, Chennai" in vivid orange #F2762E.
- On the right: circular raised bell notification button with icon.

2. Heading & Status:
- Big prominent heading: "My Home" in #1A1A1A Outfit bold. Right-aligned status label or subtle indicator if needed.
- Full-round pill search bar: "Search devices" with a search line icon and placeholder text, subtle #ECE7E1 or white background with border.
- Small weather/usage status line below search: "24°C inside · 6.2 kWh today" with subtle temperature and energy lightning bolt line icons.

3. Room Filter Chips:
- Horizontal scrolling pill row:
  - "All" (active pill: solid orange #F2762E fill with white text)
  - "Living room" (pill: #ECE7E1 background, #1A1A1A text)
  - "Bedroom" (pill: #ECE7E1 background, #1A1A1A text)
  - "Kitchen" (pill: #ECE7E1 background, #1A1A1A text)

4. 2-Column Grid of Device Cards (rounded 20-24px radius, soft subtle drop shadow or clean border):
  - Card 1: "Living lights", 4 lamps. FULL ORANGE CARD (#F2762E background, white text). Contains a lightbulb line icon, an active ON toggle switch (white knob/track), and a small pill chip "On" (white/20% opacity).
  - Card 2: "Air conditioner", 22°C · Auto. White card (#FFFFFF), fan/AC line icon, active ON toggle (#F2762E), small pill chip "On" with an orange dot indicator.
  - Card 3: "Smart TV", Off. White card (#FFFFFF), monitor/tv line icon, OFF toggle (muted grey track), small pill chip "Off".
  - Card 4: "Wi-Fi router", 8 devices. White card (#FFFFFF), router/wifi line icon, ON toggle (#F2762E), small status indicator "Online" with green/orange dot.

5. Floating Bottom Navigation Bar:
- Floating pill-shaped bar resting above the bottom edge, rounded-full, light surface #FFFFFF or #ECE7E1 with soft shadow.
- 4 line icons: Home (active, colored #F2762E), Rooms / Tune, Energy / Bolt, Settings.
- Centered raised round orange #F2762E Floating Action Button with a white "+" icon.
screens.title: Hearth - Home Dashboard (Light)

outputComponents.text:
Here is the **Hearth Home Dashboard** in **Light Mode**, crafted to your exact specifications:

### Design Highlights
- **Color Palette & Contrast**: Applied the warm off-white canvas (`#F5F2EE`), crisp white cards (`#FFFFFF`), raised controls (`#ECE7E1`), charcoal ink typography (`#1A1A1A`), and muted warm grey subtext (`#8C8782`).
- **Signature Orange Accent (`#F2762E`)**: Highlighted the active "Living lights" card with full orange fill and white text/controls, active ON toggles, the "All" room filter pill, and the centered circular floating action button (`+`).
- **Header & Ambient Status**: Features Aarav's profile avatar, "Home, Chennai" location, notification bell, big bold "My Home" title in Outfit geometric sans, full-pill search bar, and inline indoor temperature (`24°C inside`) / daily energy consumption (`6.2 kWh today`) metrics.
- **2-Column Device Grid**: 24px rounded cards with custom toggle switches and status indicators for Living lights, Air conditioner, Smart TV, and Wi-Fi router.
- **Floating Pill Bottom Navigation**: Floating elevated bar featuring Home (active orange), Rooms/Grid, Energy/Bolt, and Settings, anchored with the raised orange `+` FAB.

Design the Energy monitoring dashboard showing real-time kWh graphs

screens.name: projects/11119557533319828808/screens/5b4e0b98e8de40dab8a0946719f389b4
screens.prompt:
Design the mobile smart home control app screen "Climate Detail" in LIGHT mode for "Hearth".

Strict visual styling requirements:
- Device viewport: 390x844 mobile screen, exact fit without awkward overflow.
- Background color: warm off-white page background `#F5F2EE`.
- Cards: white `#FFFFFF` cards, soft rounded corners 20-24px radius, subtle border or soft warm drop shadow (border border-[#ECE7E1] or shadow-sm).
- Raised controls / secondary elements: `#ECE7E1`.
- Text & typography: Charcoal ink `#1A1A1A` for prominent headings/values, muted warm grey `#8C8782` for small labels and subtext. Font: clean geometric sans 'Outfit' or modern sans-serif (bold large headings, small uppercase/medium muted subtext).
- Vivid orange accent: `#F2762E` used purposefully for active status pill, active mode button, circular dial progress arc and knob, active step indicators, active switch toggle, and the primary CTA button.
- Clean rounded icons (Google Material Symbols style: arrow_back, more_vert, ac_unit/mode_fan/water_drop/thermostat, schedule, check). No gradients, no emoji.

Screen layout & content hierarchy:
1. Status Bar: Clean mobile status bar at top (9:41, wifi, battery, dark charcoal text).
2. Top Bar: Round back button on the left (raised circle button bg-[#ECE7E1] or white), Title "Living room" centered (bold charcoal), and round more options button on the right (three dots icon).
3. Status badge / Zone banner:
   - Small status chip or banner: "Climate Zone 1 · Main Living Area" with a small pill badge "Cooling" with an orange active indicator dot (`#F2762E`). (Can include subtle soft warm interior photography banner or clean minimal pill badge).
4. Thermostat Dial Section:
   - Big prominent circular thermostat dial.
   - SVG circular ring dial with a thick muted grey track (#ECE7E1 or #E2DDD6) and a vivid orange arc (#F2762E) covering 60% of the circle, terminating in a crisp white knob/handle with orange ring or drop shadow.
   - Center readout: "TARGET" in muted warm grey (#8C8782, uppercase tracked-wide text-xs), huge bold "22°" in charcoal ink (#1A1A1A, font-bold text-5xl), and below it "Inside 24°" with a small thermometer icon.
   - Flanking controls: Left side has a circular minus button (w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#ECE7E1] text-[#1A1A1A]), Right side has a circular plus button (w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#ECE7E1] text-[#1A1A1A]).
5. Mode Selector Row:
   - 4 circular/pill mode buttons:
     * "Cool" (active: vivid orange background #F2762E, white snowflake icon and white text "Cool").
     * "Heat" (inactive: raised circle bg-[#ECE7E1] or white, muted text and fire/flame icon).
     * "Dry" (inactive: raised circle bg-[#ECE7E1] or white, muted text and water drop icon).
     * "Fan" (inactive: raised circle bg-[#ECE7E1] or white, muted text and fan icon).
6. Detail Settings Cards (white #FFFFFF rounded-2xl p-4 mb-3):
   - "Fan speed": Fan icon on left, label "Fan speed" and subtext "Level 2 · Standard", and on the right a 3-step pill selector with step dots/numbers 1, 2, 3 where 1 & 2 are active orange (#F2762E) and 3 is muted.
   - "Schedule": Clock icon on left, label "Schedule" and subtext "Comfort · 6:00 PM – 11:00 PM", and on the right a toggle switch in ON state (vivid orange track #F2762E with white thumb).
7. Bottom Action:
   - Full-width vivid orange pill button: "Apply" with a small checkmark icon (bg-[#F2762E] text-white font-semibold py-4 rounded-full shadow-md text-base text-center).
   - Bottom home bar indicator for mobile.
   - STRICT CONSTRAINT: No bottom nav bar on this detail screen! Keep it clean and dedicated to climate control.
screens.title: Hearth - Climate Detail (Light)

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the **Hearth - Climate Detail** screen in light mode according to your exact specifications:

### Visual Design & Hierarchy
- **Palette & Typography**: Set on a warm off-white canvas (`#F5F2EE`) using crisp white cards (`#FFFFFF`), raised circular controls in soft beige-grey (`#ECE7E1`), deep charcoal ink (`#1A1A1A`) for high-contrast headers, and muted warm grey (`#8C8782`) for subtle metadata and secondary labels.
- **Top Bar**: Includes rounded tactile action buttons on the left and right (Back and More options) with "Living room" centered, accompanied by a clean zone badge with an active orange "Cooling" status pill.
- **Thermostat Dial**: Features an arc dial with a vivid orange progress sweep (`#F2762E`), indicator knob, a prominent `22°` target temperature readout with `Inside 24°` ambient report, flanked by raised circular minus and plus stepper controls.
- **Mode Controls**: Quick mode pills highlighting active **Cool** in vivid orange alongside Heat, Dry, and Fan states.
- **Settings Cards**: Rounded white cards for **Fan speed** with a 3-step selector and **Schedule** with active orange toggle switch.
- **Action**: Grounded with a full-width pill **Apply** CTA button with a confirmation checkmark and no bottom navigation bar, optimized for a clean 390×844 mobile viewport.

screens.prompt:
Design a mobile smart home screen for 'Hearth' in LIGHT mode:
Target device viewport: 390x844 mobile view.
Strict Color Palette & Styling:
- Background: Warm off-white #F5F2EE
- Cards: Crisp white #FFFFFF with soft border or subtle shadow, border-radius 20px to 24px
- Controls / Inactive fills: Raised #ECE7E1
- Text colors: Charcoal ink #1A1A1A for titles & prominent numbers, Muted warm grey #8C8782 for secondary/subtext
- Accent: ONE vivid orange #F2762E used intentionally for active pills, highlights, active nav icon, the centered + FAB, and one active scene card
- Typography: Clean geometric sans (Outfit or Inter), bold large headlines, clean muted labels. No emoji, no gradients.
- Thin clean modern line icons (Material Symbols Outlined / SVG).

Screen Structure:
1. Top bar: Back arrow button (circular button bg-white/raised), centered title 'Energy' (charcoal #1A1A1A font-bold text-lg), right three-dot more menu icon.
2. Segmented Pill Tab Bar:
   - Full-round pill container (#ECE7E1 or #FFFFFF with pill outline).
   - 3 tabs: 'Day', 'Week' (active with vivid orange #F2762E bg, crisp white text, font-semibold), 'Month' (muted #8C8782 text).
3. Big Energy Consumption Card (white card #FFFFFF, rounded-3xl p-5):
   - Header row: Large bold stat '142.6' with 'kWh' suffix, subtext 'Total consumption this week' in #8C8782.
   - Right badge/chip: '-12% vs last week' in a subtle neutral/muted pill (#ECE7E1 bg, #1A1A1A text with trending_down icon, NO green).
   - 7-bar rounded vertical bar chart:
     - Days labeled 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'.
     - Rounded vertical bars with varying heights.
     - 'Thu' (Thursday) bar is vivid orange #F2762E, labeled with bold/orange 'Thu'.
     - All other day bars are muted warm grey/beige (#ECE7E1 or #DDD7CE).
4. Top Consumers Section:
   - Header: 'TOP CONSUMERS' (uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs font-semibold text-[#8C8782]), right side '78% of total'.
   - White card or grouped list (#FFFFFF rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-4):
     - Item 1: Air conditioner icon in circle, title 'Air conditioner', subtitle '34% of usage', bold value '48 kWh', slim horizontal progress bar with 34% filled in orange #F2762E.
     - Item 2: Water heater icon in circle, title 'Water heater', subtitle '22% of usage', bold value '31 kWh', slim horizontal progress bar with 22% filled in warm charcoal/neutral.
     - Item 3: Lights icon in circle, title 'Lights', subtitle '10% of usage', bold value '14 kWh', slim horizontal progress bar with 10% filled in warm neutral.
5. Scenes Section:
   - Header: 'Scenes' (text-lg font-bold text-[#1A1A1A]), right side '4 Active presets' or subtle count.
   - 2-column grid of scene cards (rounded-2xl p-4):
     - Card 1: 'Good morning' (white #FFFFFF card, sunrise/wb_sunny icon, toggle switch OFF, subtext '7:00 AM').
     - Card 2: 'Movie night' (FULL ORANGE #F2762E card, white text, movie/theaters icon, toggle switch ON with white knob, subtext 'Active now').
     - Card 3: 'Away' (white #FFFFFF card, logout/directions_walk icon, toggle switch OFF, subtext 'Eco mode').
     - Card 4: 'Sleep' (white #FFFFFF card, bed/nightlight icon, toggle switch OFF, subtext '11:00 PM').
6. Floating Bottom Navigation Bar:
   - Floating rounded-full pill bar (bg-[#FFFFFF] or translucent warm white, soft shadow-xl border border-[#ECE7E1]), positioned above bottom safe area.
   - 5 items: Home icon (meeting_room or home), Rooms icon (grid_view or meeting_room), Centered raised round orange FAB with '+' icon (#F2762E bg, white plus, shadow-md), Energy icon (bolt or electric_bolt - ACTIVE with orange #F2762E tint and active dot/style), Settings icon (settings or tune).
Fit comfortably within standard mobile viewport with natural scroll.
